name: Pokémon Sun & Moon
notes: Base-game pack. Encounter pools generated from PokéAPI data, merged to location level across sub-areas, encounter methods, and the paired versions (in-game trades and raid/event distributions excluded); area order is estimated from encounter levels and is approximate. Alola has no Gyms: bosses are the seven trial Totem Pokémon (team = Totem plus its documented SOS allies) interleaved with the four Grand Trial Kahunas in story order, then the Elite Four, then Professor Kukui as the Champion-equivalent final boss. First trial uses the Pokémon Sun Totem (Gumshoos); in Pokémon Moon it is Totem Raticate (Alolan Raticate Lv 12) with an Alolan Rattata (Lv 11) ally. In Sun/Moon, Kahuna Hapu challenges the player at the entrance to Vast Poni Canyon BEFORE the Kommo-o trial inside the canyon, which is why her level cap (48) is higher than Totem Kommo-o's (45) despite coming first; Kommo-o's Lv 32 SOS allies (Scizor, Hakamo-o) look low but are correct as documented by multiple sources. Kukui's last team slot varies with the player's starter; the variant recorded here is for a player who chose Rowlet (Kukui fields Incineroar). Moves, abilities and items are intentionally left blank.
